No templates found with those criteria. Could search without criteria and later pick one that looks like nitro reduction. Let's search generic and inspect results for nitro reduction.

Search with just molecule_smiles maybe of target? But we need nitro reduction template. Could search for "nitro" functional group broken. Use functional_groups_broken ["nitro"] only.


<thought>Search for any template that breaks a nitro group (functional_groups_broken=["nitro"]). No need to specify formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
  "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
